title: 2 U.S. Embassy officials among 4 killed in car crash after drug lab raid
summary: After six synthetic drug labs were raided, the victims' vehicle skidded off the road and plunged into a ravine, officials said.
contentText: Authorities initially said the accident happened while the officers were returning from the drug raids, but the Chihuahua state prosecutor later said the Americans weren't involved in those operations.
